candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion on the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order 503s, order ReadTimeouts, and gateway checkout 502s.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side pool metrics or logs admitted; pool saturation inferred from span attributes only.

report.explanation: Traces show repeated checkout 502s driven by order ReadTimeouts, with postgres.save_order failing DependencyUnavailable at pool size 5 / 0 idle across all correlation IDs. Gateway metrics confirm 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms order->postgresql dependency. Bounded candidate: db-pool-exhaustion.
